div.span:
The tools and files at each stage, from a concept image to a reviewed Blockbench model.
Scope: the machine-model pipeline in Arffornia_Assets (tools/pix, tools/lint, the machine-model skill).
Out of scope: in-game export (GeckoLib) and the mod code, not built yet.
v0.1 · source: docs/architecture/machine-pipeline
